description: Long editorial workspace with deliberate mobile overflow, a delayed promotional dialog, and a reversible disclosure.

referenceProfile.thesis: A warm editorial system uses oversized serif entry type and numbered chapters to keep an unusually long research document navigable.
signatureMoves: Chapter numbers form a stable left rail on wide screens before reflowing above the text on mobile.
Warm paper surfaces and quiet rules preserve reading continuity across repeated long sections.
transferPreserve: Keep the oversized serif entry point, numbered chapter rhythm, and restrained warm-neutral palette.
transferAvoid: Do not interpret the deliberately wide comparison board as proven responsive reflow.
